title: Who Is God? Exodus & Divine Naming

questions.prompt: Barron warns that reading Scripture well requires attention to:
choices: A Genre (not one clunky set of glasses for the whole Bible).
D Treating every line as identical genre.
questions.explain: Attentiveness to genre across diverse biblical writings.

questions.prompt: A central naming text he begins with is:
God's name revealed to Moses is rendered as:
choices: B "I was a local storm god only."
questions.explain: I AM WHO I AM revelation.

questions.prompt: The whiteout metaphor illustrates that the divine name is:
choices: A Anti-grasping—you cannot control/comprehend God as an object.
C A password for miracles on demand.

questions.prompt: Aquinas's point that God has "no real relation" to the world means, for Barron:
choices: A God is not dependent on the world (not that God doesn't care).
B God is indifferent and uncaring.
C God is a creature among creatures.
